prompt:
An agricultural drainage pump empties floodwater from a sump into an elevated canal 6.5 m vertically above the sump water level. The pump raises 540 kg of water each minute. The pump motor has an electrical power input of 750 W. Take g = 9.81 m s^-2.
Calculate:
(a) the useful work done on the water in one minute [1]
(b) the useful power output of the pump [1]
(c) the efficiency of the pumping system [1]
(d) the rate at which energy is wasted to the surroundings [1]
hints: Wasted power is the difference between total electrical input power and useful output power.
teacher_walkthrough: Part (a): Gravitational potential energy gained in 1 min is mgh = 540 * 9.81 * 6.5 = 34 433 J.
Part (b): Divide by 60 s to obtain rate: 34 433 / 60 = 573.9 W.
Part (c): Ratio of output to input: 573.9 / 750 = 0.765.
Part (d): Conservation of energy: P_wasted = P_in - P_useful = 750 - 573.9 = 176.1 W.
